concept: Foundation of the Indian National Congress
question: In December 1885, _________ delegates from different parts of India founded the Indian National Congress.
solution:
The correct answer is __**72**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **72 delegates** from different parts of India founded the Indian National Congress in December 1885.
 
• The Indian National Congress was established as a platform for civil and political dialogue among educated Indians.
 
• The first session was held in Bombay (now Mumbai) and was presided over by Womesh Chunder Bonnerjee.
 
• The formation of the Congress marked the beginning of a new phase in the Indian independence movement.
 
• The Congress played a pivotal role in the struggle for India's independence from British rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allan Octavian Hume**, a retired British civil servant, is often credited with playing a key role in the formation of the Indian National Congress.
 
• Initially, the Congress sought to obtain a greater share in government for educated Indians through constitutional means.
 
• Over the years, the Congress evolved into a mass movement that demanded full independence from British rule.
 
• The Congress was instrumental in organizing protests, boycotts, and other forms of civil disobedience against British policies.
 
• Prominent leaders of the Congress included Mahatma Gandhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, Sardar Patel, and many others who played crucial roles in India's fight for freedom.
